summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG across an authored Level 0 maze, authored deeper levels, and shared destinations. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place simulations and shared scripts own local environments, combat, NPCs, loot, crafting, UI, avatar presentation, progression, and reusable world systems.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade games, salon and visual effects.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates maze furniture and loot, safe rooms, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade and Zenith's sealed breach.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking space and staged tutorial route with HALOGEN.
places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1 Zenith Station: station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, recorder quest and drone-refilled posts.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone: seeded parking-garage/concrete maze, M.E.G. camp, searchable stock and generated upper parking deck with ramps, bays, lights and props.
places/level2 + places/level21 (3D) - Pipe Dreams and Level 2.1 'Locked'; Level 2 sim seeds industrial rooms, survivor camp, modeled fixtures/doors and fitted break-room props.
places/level3, gamma, level4, level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems and generated details.

places/level6, level7, level10, level11, level12, level26, level27 (3D) - later levels include Level 11 city/crawl/vaults, Level 26 quests and the Level 27 Bunker Springs cave; home11 is not present in the current place tree.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, ordered behavior composition and keyboard/touch action mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place configuration, authored placements and local generated/ticked behavior; main, Level 11, Level 27 and other sims build their environments.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene, BODIES toggle and solo pause time-scale.
places/level1/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1.js + scripts/level1-geo.js, level1-details-geo.js, level1-deck-geo.js - seeded Level 1 ground-floor/deck generation and shared deck/ramp layout.
places/level1/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/dina-diary.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - Dina camp/diary entry and quest progression; Voss and Cabin 23/Phoebe/stow-nest interactions are in Level 26.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js + scripts/ui.js - camera, third-person toggle, HUD and panels; scripts/loot-ui.js renders HALOGEN inventory, quick slots and carried tapes.
scripts/quest-marker.js + scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - per-player journal, tracking, objective resolution and markers; folds legacy quest state into shared records.
places/level27/sim.js + places/level27/cells/x0z0.scene - Level 27 cave/spring local construction and its two authored roof-light placements; sim also owns mineral nodes and bath tick.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, and LEVEL_NAMES used by hub-ui; includes Level 27 · The Bunker Springs.

scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, item descriptions, weapon definitions/rarity and variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js - parametric leaf/frame/sealed-set geometry and eased hinge motion/sounds shared by built doors and level-specific doors.

scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js + scripts/lib/level11-depths.js + scripts/l11-crawl-geo.js + scripts/lib/data/l11-depths.yml + scripts/lib/data/l11-crawl-kit.yml - Level 11 security gates, crawl geometry/data, rooms, foe roster and storeroom.

scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml + scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml - canonical breakable/material/build specs and furniture models shared by B-mode, harvesting and reconstruction.
scripts/lib/data/craft.yml + scripts/lib/craft.js - recipe catalog, skill/bench requirements, ingredients and outputs; craft helpers are shared by action and UI.
scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only screen classifier and wrist gates; scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js resolve quest records and goals; NPC lore/talk data feed talk handlers.

scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/maze0path.js and scripts/lib/critter-model.js + avatar hair/face/wardrobe data - shared Level 0 layout/navigation and fitted human/furry avatar assembly, skinning, faces, hair and garments.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickSnap, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, fishing handlers, HOLO and holoEnd; throwable fuse/arm callbacks and blast hits.
scripts/lib/quick-items.js - quickItems, assignQuick; scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.

scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - body/face/head/spec, hair and wardrobe seating, restyle/clearAppearance, humanBodyMorph, speciesOf, anime, FURRY_HEAD and STYLE_V (sw79).
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
scripts/lib/craft.js - recipeStatus, maxMakes, craftOne, benchAvailable, scrapCount, CRAFT_LIMIT, CATS; scripts/craft.js - onInput, update.
scripts/lib/stats.js - skillsOf, SKILLS, canCarry, canCarryAll and carry/weight helpers; Level 11 city/depths/vault helpers export their lay/tick APIs.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, heat/cold, carried tapes and playback.

scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - dinaQ, dinaDiary and dcut, and seeds player.state.quests['the-way-back']; scripts/lib/quests.js owns player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; level quest handlers own their per-player quest fields.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, drag/heave/throw session fields and carryMul; held targets own heldBy/down/stagger state.

scripts/lib/loose.js + scripts/lib/breakables.js - loose props own state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and flight sessions; breakables own wreck transitions and record permanently smashed root objects in place.state.gone for rebuilds.
scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - foe attributes/weight and shared down/stagger knock outcomes; enemy managers retain AI state and write player-targeting sneakTarget.

scripts/lib/quick-items.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.quickSlots maps digit slots to item IDs; assignQuick validates unique carried items and player quick-use executes actions; scripts/lib/feed.js writes player.state.feed/disc.
places/level1/sim.js and places/level2/sim.js - place.state version markers own one-time seeded/dressing/fixture/door migrations.

places/level27/sim.js - place.state.builtV and gone own versioned cave layout and mineral regrowth timers; player.state.bathAt tracks continuous bathing, while scripts/l27-use.js changes thirst, sanity and notice on spring-water use.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player/foe-steps, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3/quest-marker; touch mappings provide corresponding mobile controls.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes aimPt and ranged aimPitch → player.js ballistics.

scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs; toHub/toSolo perform crossings and track roomHop/save-place state.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; menu UI renders on menuOpen and solo pause sets place.timeScale.

scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle; scripts/critter.js applies style and sweeps occupants through critter-model.js; Avatar look/state.wear → body/head/hair/mask/beard/wardrobe children, with STYLE_V prompting refit/restyle.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js seatHead compares the current body model with state.headBody → clearAppearance removes incompatible skinned attachments and seats them on the new rig; player/critter update paths recover avatar and held-weapon presentation after unexpected restamps.
scripts/lib/hub.js destinations → hub-ui.js and world/player crossings; Bonus Room sim lays NPCs/effects, while hubOffer and mall counters write shop/food state read by handlers and UI.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; weapon variants roll through weapons.js.

Player and M.E.G. combat handlers → scripts/lib/body3.js stance/swing/fire/aim/reload → combat-anims.yml; weapons.yml supplies firearm cycle/sfx/chamber data to player.js and vmpose.js, while stats.js and ballistics.js apply skill/handling.

scripts/player.js hitAt/hitHeavy and jammedAt → scripts/lib/vmpose.js held viewmodel recoil/jolt; NV melee swing rows in nv-swings.js are smoothly sampled there; third-person body stance and first-person viewmodel share weapon families.

Craft UI reads craft.yml, skill/bench status and inventory via scripts/lib/craft.js → sends make action to scripts/craft.js; craftOne drafts complete input/output batches before committing player state, with carry checks, optional bonus outputs and reachable/visible/clear workbench validation.

Level 0 main sim → maze.js seeded geometry/cell helpers and level0-moments.js; moments.js handles placed moments; smilers/lurkers use maze0path and sneak.crouchMul while hunter managers publish pursuit cues.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/lib/bonus-extra.js + mall-shopper.js/salon-stylist.js/salon-ui.js - authored mall, simulated mall life and one-time neon/fountain lighting effects.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + home reconstruction scripts - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence and rebuild path.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + build-door and level-specific door handlers - shared parametric leaves/frames and eased hinge motion; Level 2's versioned door pass migrates pre-existing fixtures.

places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + scripts/zenith-door.js + scripts/zenith-bots.js + scripts/zenith-hatch.js + scripts/zenith-flicker.js + scripts/zenith-drones.js + scripts/zenith-use.js - Zenith Station geometry, doors, breach, bots, hazards and station quests.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js + scripts/lib/l4-people.js/level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js/level5-people.yml - authored office/hotel with role-, look-, dialogue- and schedule-driven residents.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/faces/hair/model/wardrobe data + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-body/* + art/body-rig/* + art/body-transfer/* + scripts/mat-anime.js - shared human/furry avatar assembly, skinned attachments and fitted garments; body swaps clear stale children and hair data maps GLB material slots.

art/nv-melee/retarget.py + smooth.py + scripts/lib/data/nv-swings.js + scripts/lib/vmpose.js - decoded New Vegas melee takes retargeted to the human rig, smoothed for first-person timing and sampled for melee viewmodel swings; weapon styles vary by weapon family.

scripts/lib/nav.js + scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/l5-staff.js + scripts/l61-staff.js - independent NPC walkers share exact-endpoint/options-aware, short-lived path cache and query budget; Level 26 quest trail points to Voss.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Human rig/wardrobe refresh is STYLE_V = sw79; art/body-rig/assets.json pins body and fitted garment outputs. Keep game skeleton/bone names, animation axes, face/head, hands, morph keys and weights when replacing transferred meshes.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js humanBodyMorph omits unsupported male Bust on the body while humanMorph keeps its explicit zero for garments; body changes compare state.headBody and clear/reseat skinned attachments, without deleting equipment children.
art/body-transfer/reshape.py reshapes the game rig/rest pose to approved body joint positions while preserving game bone names, face/morph keys, and downstream bones.json/field.json contracts.

art/body-transfer/fit.py uses optional FIT_MIN (default 0.005; women's tank used 0.012); it fits garments to the reshaped skin with clearance and carries deltas across shape keys. wardrobe-split.yml keeps body skin separate from skinned wardrobe children; hair GLBs use hair-slots.yml to restrict material overrides to existing slots.

Crafting output grants are copy-on-write: validate all inputs and every output token before committing state; consumed input weight frees capacity first and a failed optional bonus must not reject the base batch. Keep the 100 craft-per-request bound and bench reach/line-of-sight checks.

Level 27's sim version is V=10; its cave build migration and place.state.gone mineral regrowth (180 seconds) are place-owned. Keep pool/tunnel positions and exit behavior aligned with scripts/l27-use.js and the home tub crossing markers.
